fields.description: If checked, a Material Request cannot be raised with a Transaction Date earlier than today.
fields.label: Restrict Backdated PR

fields.description: If checked, a Purchase Material Request can only consume the budget allocated to its own month (as per the Budget's Monthly Distribution). Unused budget of earlier months is not carried forward.
fields.label: Restrict PR to Current Month Budget

fields.description: If checked, ERPNext's standard budget check on a Purchase Material Request uses the PR's Transaction Date (the month it is raised) instead of its Required By date to pick the month and fiscal year of the budget. Pending PRs are also matched to the fiscal year by Transaction Date.
fields.label: Use Transaction Date for PR Budget Check
